decisions.statement: A locked phone's health store is shut to every read.
The app coming forward is the one moment the phone is certainly unlocked.
The phone drains its health samples without anyone running a shortcut.
A run the app started posts no notice and reports as every other run does.
A quarter hour is spent before a run rather than after it.
A run that never got to start costs a quarter hour and loses no sample.
A run says it began before that run reads a thing.
A run that began and never finished reads apart from a run that never began.

definition: the Swift draining health samples when the app comes forward
